title: OpenVINO tokenizers wheel build fails - openvino~=2026.5.0.dev not yet available on pip

failed_jobs.symptom: pip cannot find openvino~=2026.5.0.dev; build dependencies install fails

key_errors: ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement openvino~=2026.5.0.dev (from versions: ..., 2026.4.0.dev20260827)
ERROR: No matching distribution found for openvino~=2026.5.0.dev

root_cause: The openvino_tokenizers package requires openvino~=2026.5.0.dev as a build dependency, but the highest available dev version on the pip index is 2026.4.0.dev20260827. The nightly/dev 2026.5.x build has not been published yet. This is a pipeline dependency timing issue where the tokenizer wheel's version constraint is ahead of the published nightly package. The PR under test (fixing a C API test) is entirely unrelated to this failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - the failure depends on the nightly openvino package being published to the pip index.
recommended_actions: Wait for the 2026.5.0.dev nightly OpenVINO package to be published and re-run the pipeline.
Check if openvino_tokenizers version constraint can be relaxed to allow the latest available dev build (2026.4.0.dev20260827).
Re-add the PR to the merge queue after the nightly package is available.
prevention_strategies: Ensure that nightly OpenVINO package publishing is completed before merge queue jobs that depend on the dev version are triggered. Consider implementing a dependency availability check step before the tokenizers build.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of this specific version mismatch pattern.
